description.value: Sunny Shores Resort & Marina is a family-oriented resort on Sooke Basin, located on Highway 14 about 30 km west of Victoria — a key stretch of Vancouver Island's south-shore cycling corridor. The property combines motel units, tent and trailer campsites with fire pits and picnic tables, and a full marina with boat launch, fuel, and charter fishing. On-site extras include a laundromat, 19-hole mini-golf, a tackle and convenience store stocked with basic food and camping supplies, and a children's playground.
